blocks.text: Setting up Google Sheets on your Mac

Google Sheets does not have a native Mac application. You should use Google Chrome for the best experience. You can create a desktop shortcut that acts like an app. Open sheets.google.com in Chrome. Click the three-dot menu in the top right corner. Select Cast, Save, and Share. Then click Install page as app. This creates a dedicated window for your spreadsheets.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for sales analysts

Speed is vital when you manage large sales datasets. Use ⌘ + / to open the full list of shortcuts. Press ⌘ + ⇧ + H to open the Find and Replace tool. Use ⌘ + ⌥ + 9 to hide rows and ⌘ + ⌥ + 0 to hide columns. These shortcuts save time when you prepare reports for leadership.

Sales operations analysts spend hours cleaning data. Use the built-in tools to remove duplicate rows. Select your data range. Go to Data > Data cleanup > Remove duplicates. This ensures your revenue forecasts are based on accurate information. Always keep a raw backup copy of your data in a separate tab before running cleanup tools.

You often need to track quota attainment and pipeline health. Use pivot tables to summarize large datasets. Highlight your data range. Go to Insert > Pivot table. Drag your sales rep names to rows and deal values to values. This gives you an instant view of performance across teams.

Google Sheets now supports up to 20 million cells per spreadsheet. If your sheet feels slow, reduce the number of complex formulas. Use Paste special > Values only to convert formulas into static data. This significantly reduces calculation load and improves responsiveness.

CRM exports often come as CSV files. Go to File > Import to bring these into your sheet. Choose to replace the current sheet or create a new one. If your data does not align correctly, use Data > Split text to columns to fix formatting issues.

faq.question: Is there a native Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, Google Sheets is a web-based app. You can create a PWA shortcut in Chrome to make it feel like a standalone Mac application.

faq.question: How do I speed up a slow Google Sheet?
faq.answer: Reduce the number of complex formulas. Copy and paste your data as values only to remove the calculation overhead.

faq.question: What is the cell limit in Google Sheets?
faq.answer: As of September 2026, the limit is 20 million cells per spreadsheet.
